name: cell-sorting-spatial
description: The sorting study flagship: a mixed 8x8 checkerboard of alternating-type 5x5-px CPM cells (64 cells total, 32 type-1 / 32 type-2, on a 70x70 lattice) demixes under differential-adhesion contact energetics alone (CpmSorting, the verified checkerboard config from tests/test_cpm_sorting.py) -- NO fields, NO metabolism/cobra path, this is the sorting *primitive* in isolation. Contact energies are tuned Steinberg-style: same-type contact is cheap (J(1,1)=J(2,2)=2.0), cross-type contact is expensive (J(1,2)=11.0), and contact with medium sits in between (J(0,1)=J(0,2)=8.0) -- so cells minimize free energy by clustering with their own type and pulling away from the other, at temperature=10.0 (Metropolis fluctuation scale). Each tick runs 10 Monte Carlo steps (mcs) of CPM copy attempts; hetero_frac (the fraction of intercell 4-neighbor lattice edges between two DIFFERENT live cells) collapses from its well-mixed checkerboard starting value toward a sorted low value while cell_pixels (the cohesion guard) and the per-type cell counts stay constant -- verified end-to-end in tests/test_cpm_sorting.py's Composite run.
